name: @buildpilot/desktop
description: BuildPilot system-tray desktop app (Electron) — runs the server in the background, shows pipeline notifications, and opens the dashboard from the tray.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:server
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:resources && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:resources && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:resources && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:resources && electron-builder --linux
